dict.string: Hey! reads only the URL and title of the front browser tab, to offer adding a YouTube video to a playlist (only when you turn it on).

Hey! reads today's appointments to show your next meeting and remind you before it starts. It looks at an appointment's location and notes only to find a Zoom, Meet or Teams link. It never edits your calendar and stores nothing (only when you turn it on).
Hey! uses the camera only when you ask it to take a photo or record a video, and keeps the files on this Mac.
Hey! uses the microphone only when you turn on recording sound with a video.
